title: Mother Pushing Baby in Stroller on Park Walkway, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A post-war mid-century snapshot capturing a young mother strolling down a paved park path while pushing her infant in a classic metal wheeled stroller-walker. The woman wears a tucked-in pleated blouse and a high-waisted dark pencil skirt, exemplifying everyday late 1940s to early 1950s American fashion. To her right stretches an open lawn bordered by mature trees and a body of water, while a globe lamppost and parked vintage automobiles line the roadway to the left.
